title: 第1073章 假戏真做第1072章 巨额补偿
slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 尤其是青茅山的白家还有熊家。
他们两家的人可是有着极大的可能盯着他们铁家的错处。
万一被发现了，到时候铁家好不容易得到的处境又该怎样转危为安？
所以难道真的便就是要在这块假戏真做不成？
这样的想法徐徐落下，铁珊瑚那张粉扑扑的小脸儿一时间也满满的全是纠结。
所以说他也是一位名副其实的大罗之境，而且也获得了大罗玄仙之境的传承，甚至未来可期。
可该说不说。
他如今终究还是有着那小小感情的女儿心的。
此前可从未喜欢过什么人，对于楚风这可是第一次的。
不然的话，按照他铁珊瑚原本的心性，那可绝对是百分百的修仙为主。
唯有修行，才能掌握自身的命运；唯有修行，才能让它变得更强。
这不仅仅是他铁珊瑚一人的做派，甚至对于这片天地之中绝大多数的人，都是这份做派的，并不会因此发生什么太大的改变。
而铁正义则主动来到了楚风的身前，幽深的目光朝他轻轻地看了一眼，紧接着面颊间便就流露出了一份淡淡的笑意。
正所谓知子莫若父。
旁人或许不知道自家女儿的性情，但是他铁正义还是很了解的。
女儿或许是有着些许的小聪明，但相比较两大家族这样的琐事，女儿却是绝然难以处理得了的。
所以在这表面之外，绝对是另有其人。
这一点他铁正义也可以笃定。
而现如今在铁家之中的外人可就只有一个，所以答案并不难猜。
只不过有些事情，铁正义还是需要稍微做上一些工作处置才好的，不用急于一时。
没过多久，铁珊瑚、铁秋雨他们两人一个个的也便全部回来。
没有了外人。
他们三人齐齐地聚在一处。
铁正义到了此时方才是把话说的足够清楚：“眼下还是尽快说上一说，这件事情究竟是谁开的金口？”
此话一说，铁珊瑚下意识地准备站出来举起手，表示他就是当之无愧的最大赢家、最大功臣。
可紧接着，父亲淡淡的目光只是稍稍袭来，下一刻他铁珊瑚缩了缩脖子，嘿嘿一笑就开始了装傻充愣。
而铁秋雨在家主大人这大罗巅峰之境的压迫之下，更是连头都不敢抬。
家主大人的威严何许。
她这刚突破的大罗之境没多久的家伙怎么可能会反抗？
那真是老寿星吃砒霜。绝对的不想活了，妥妥的给自己自找麻烦。
“年轻人，是你怎么着？
当真喜欢上我这女孩了？
既然你喜欢上了，那便就依了你的性子。
从今日起，你便就是我铁家的人了。
如何？
挑选一个黄道吉日，你们二人便就准备一场婚礼。
至于赘婿不赘婿的，不用放在心上。
只要日后你同珊瑚生下一儿半女，其中一子随我铁家的姓，便自然而然能够堵得住这里的一众悠悠之口，这便足够了。
凭借年轻人你的聪慧，应该不会拒绝的。”
content_en:
Especially the Bai family and the Xiong family in Qingmao Mountain.
People from these two families are very likely to focus on the mistakes of their Tie family.
If they are discovered, how can the Tie family turn the situation around?
So is it really possible to do this fake show?
Such thoughts slowly faded away, and Tie Hualou's pink face was full of tangles for a while.
Therefore, he is also a veritable Daluo realm, and has also obtained the inheritance of the Daluo Xuanxian realm, and even has a promising future.
Should I say it or not?
After all, he still has that little emotional heart of a daughter.
I have never liked anyone before, and this is the first time for Chu Feng.
Otherwise, according to his original character of Iron Coral, he is definitely 100% focused on cultivating immortality.
Only by practicing can you control your own destiny; only by practicing can you make it stronger.
This is not only the style of Tie Hualu, but also the style of the vast majority of people in this world, and it will not change much as a result.
Tie Zhengyi took the initiative to come to Chu Feng, glanced at him gently with deep eyes, and then a faint smile appeared on his cheeks.
As the saying goes, no one knows his son better than his father.
Others may not know his daughter's temperament, but he, Tie Zhengyi, still knows it very well.
The daughter may be a little clever, but compared to the trivial matters of the two big families, it is absolutely difficult for the daughter to handle.
So there is definitely someone else beyond this surface.
He can be sure of this with iron justice.
But now there is only one outsider in the Tie family, so the answer is not difficult to guess.
It's just that there are some things that Tie Zhengyi still needs to do some work to deal with, so there is no need to rush.
Not long after, Tie Hualou and Tie Qiuyu came back one by one.
No more outsiders.
The three of them gathered together.
Only at this moment did Tie Zhengyi speak clearly enough: "Now we should tell you as soon as possible, who is the author of this matter?"
As soon as he said this, Tie Hualu subconsciously prepared to stand up and raise his hands to show that he was the well-deserved biggest winner and biggest contributor.
But then, his father's indifferent gaze only hit him for a moment, and the next moment he shrank his neck, chuckled, and started to pretend to be dumbfounded.
And Tie Qiuyu did not even dare to raise his head under the pressure of his master, who was at the pinnacle of Da Luo.
How majestic is the master of the house?
How could she, who had just broken through to Da Luo Realm not long ago, resist?
That's really the old man eating arsenic. I absolutely don’t want to live anymore and I’m just asking for trouble for myself.
"Young man, what's wrong with you?
Are you really in love with this girl like me?
Since you like it, then I will follow your temper.
From today on, you are a member of my Tie family.
How?
Pick an auspicious day and the two of you will prepare for a wedding.
As for those who have a son-in-law or not, don’t take it to heart.
As long as you and Huanhuan have a son and a half in the future, and one of them takes my Tie family name, he will naturally be able to stop the mouths of all the people here, and that will be enough.
With your intelligence as a young man, you should not be able to refuse. "
